name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Crispy Golden Chimichanga (Deep-Fried Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Unlike a soft flour burrito, chimichangas are deep-fried until crunchy, resulting in heavy oil absorption. Digestible in remission, but order a soft burrito during flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If feeling sensitive, order a soft smothered burrito instead of a deep-fried chimichanga with mild red sauce.
watchOuts: Deep-fried flour tortilla carries high oil content
